exact_accent_overrides.author_reason: Classical Latin pronunciation may be reused before the module that stores it.
The supplied liturgical reading tradition is kept from Dark Ages onward, not made the default for republican Latin.
Humanist reading tradition belongs to Renaissance and Early Modern, although its source record is preserved in other installations.

matching.marker_mode: case-insensitive substring; markers only narrow, never widen
matching.never_match: player descriptions, display-era language aliases, generated numeric IDs

roles.learner_or_foreign: source DefaultLearnerAccent pointer OR group foreign/crude/learner (case-insensitive); explicit source accent names Foreign/Crude/Learner also qualify
roles.native-tradition: all other source accents, unless an exact override sets a role; native-tradition does not mean learners can never select it

generated_fallback.local: available only for installed canonical language and allowed language era; generated when no era-valid native-tradition candidate exists, even if preserved out-of-era accents exist
generated_fallback.learner: available for non-native applicants when language is installed; empty native ethnicity set means not-native is true
generated_fallback.stock_learner_role_repair: replace the unchanged PR732-owned AlwaysFalse pointer by managed role/era eligibility; do not alter independent or builder-edited restrictions

availability_rule: effective era eligibility AND source-specific original predicate AND role predicate; native-tradition role predicate is true; learner/foreign/crude role predicate is NOT ethnic native. No first-eligible fallback may silently grant a native accent to an acquired language.
original_predicate_policy: Null source predicate means true. Preserve genuine custom predicates. The documented unchanged PR732-owned synthetic learner AlwaysFalse is a seed defect, not a genuine original restriction.
state_owner: One managed AccentAvailability record owns the combined pointer; other scalar passes exclude that field. Preserve edited combined progs and edited pointers using three-way reconciliation.
no_native_binding_languages: Evaluate all installed language IDs, not only keys present in the native-ethnicity dictionary.
partial_seed_policy: Apply era policy on language-only installs. If heritage has never been installed use an empty native set for role evaluation; a later full run rebuilds it. If heritage already exists preserve/recover its current fixed native bindings on language-only rerun.
audit_required: Emit one row per imported/generated accent with source identity, canonical language, role, selected rule, allowed packs, source predicate, effective pointer, builder override and default status. The policy is deliberately broad, not a census of dialect history.
